p: affinity with Ahab: For Joram Jehoshaphat's son married Ahab's daughter.
years he went down to Ahab: That is, the third year, 1Ki 22:2.
Ramothgilead: To recover it out of the hands of the Syrians.
word of the LORD to day: Hear the advise of some prophet to know whether it is God's will.
prophets four hundred men: Who were the prophets of Baal, signifying that the wicked esteem none but liars and such as will bear with their inordinate affections.
hate him: Yet the true ministers of God should not cease to do their duty, even though the wicked magistrates cannot abide them speaking the truth.
so: Meaning, that he should not refuse to hear any that was from God.
robes: That is, in their majesty and royal apparel.
horns of iron: Read 1Ki 22:11.
assent: Thinking, that since four hundred prophets had agreed in one thing, that he being but one man and in least estimation, did not dare to go against it.
Go ye up: He spoke this in derision of the false prophets as the king well knew.
These have no master: He prophesied of how the people would be scattered and Ahab slain.
host of heaven standing on his: Meaning his angels.
the LORD said: That is, the Lord.
lying spirit in the mouth of: To those who would not believe the truth, God sent a strong delusion, that they would believe lies, 2Th 2:10.
cheek: By this cruelty his ambition and hypocrisy was discovered; thus the hypocrites boast of the Spirit which they do not have, and declare their malice against them on whom the true Spirit is.
affliction and with water of affliction: Keep him in prison, and let him feel hunger and thirst.
disguise myself: Thus the wicked think by their own subtilty to escape God's judgments which he threatens by his word.
cried out: He cried to the Lord by acknowledging his fault in going with this wicked king to war against the word of the Lord by his prophet and also by desiring mercy for the same.
stayed himself up in his chariot: He disguised his wound that his soldiers might fight more courageously.
